bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; code=80; pg(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }; a=$(pg "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT a.announcement_id FROM announcement_posts a JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text WHERE a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND a.created_at>NOW()-interval '3 hours' GROUP BY a.announcement_id HAVING count(*) FILTER(WHERE d.status='sent')=2) q") || exit 101; test "$a" -gt 0 || code=$((code+1)); b=$(pg "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT a.announcement_id FROM announcement_posts a JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text WHERE a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND a.created_at>NOW()-interval '3 hours' GROUP BY a.announcement_id HAVING count(*) FILTER(WHERE d.status='sent')=1 AND count(*) FILTER(WHERE d.status='needs_reconcile')>0) q") || exit 102; test "$b" -gt 0 || code=$((code+2)); c=$(pg "SELECT count(*) FROM announcement_posts a WHERE a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND a.created_at>NOW()-interval '3 hours' AND a.status='draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posting_deliveries d WHERE d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.status='sent')") || exit 103; test "$c" -gt 0 || code=$((code+4)); d=$(pg "SELECT count(*) FROM announcement_posts a WHERE a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND a.created_at>NOW()-interval '3 hours' AND a.status='published' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d WHERE d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.status='sent')=2") || exit 104; test "$d" -gt 0 || code=$((code+8)); exit "$code"
